questions.open_dependency: Validate inventory state basis and scope; optional incoming supply is separately unknown if absent.
Explicit reservations or declared derived allocation and merchant priority policy.
Line-level reservation ownership cannot be inferred from an aggregate stock number.
Supplier/PO promise revisions and supply-to-order dependencies require a supplemental feed.
DHL entitlement/retention and exact shop shipment link; merchant stale-scan threshold is configurable.
Explicit customer deadline and timezone; carrier ETA is not that promise.
Per-line shipment association and handover/delivery evidence; packing gaps remain explicit.
Prior communication needs a reviewed feed or later mailbox/helpdesk integration.
Correction chain, payment markers and invoice/order links must be validated per account.
Merchant invoicing trigger plus complete invoice population and confirmed cross-system links.
Version-aligned line equivalence and currency basis; unmatched shipping/tax/discount allocation stays unresolved.
easybill postbox coverage must include external-send limitations; sending is not receipt.
Successful transaction amounts and gateway/account identity, not just order financial labels.
Complete attempt history and same-order identity; later success can still be only partial.
Proven invoice-to-payment allocation; multiple invoices and manual payments need explicit association.
Reminder policy, investigations and agreed extensions require explicit business context.
Detailed held/processing/available breakdown and independent bank coverage are not implied by the default finance API.
Complete payout member postings and signed adjustments; do not explain using all payments in a date window.
A real validated bank-statement import is required; provider payout status alone is insufficient.
A verified source for hold identity/reason/amount and release promise is still needed.
Actual line-level warehouse receipt/disposition and refund links; a return request is only intent.
Explicit refund entitlement, original payment and destination; an unpaid invoice credit may only reduce debt.
Reservation ownership and financial/warehouse reconciliation context must be available, including explicit not-applicable states.
